selection_detail: Standalone Tier-1d demand-driven run (claim buffer starved). review_cursor in state.json makes mobile-native-kmp the oldest-unreviewed segment (2026-08-25; every other segment reviewed 2026-08-28/29). No CHURN_FILES supplied and the hotspot_history is stale (May/Jun) and points at backend routes, so churn-alignment did not fire. Saturation check: 0 open code-review-finding items for any segment in backlog.json, so no saturation-skip. Static-only Kotlin/KMP review (grep sweep + targeted reads; no gradle/compile/test). The segment is well-defended overall: ApiClient wraps every request in try/catch, all Repository classes return Result via runCatching/try, SsoService.validateAndLogin fully catches network exceptions and routes failures into AuthState.Error, the iOS actuals (SsoStateStore.ios, PlatformConfig) are real implementations (not stubs), the SSO deep-link CSRF nonce is consumed before token validation, and the guarded `!!` uses in Compose screens (ListingDetailScreen etc.) are when-branch smart-cast workarounds, not unchecked network/DB nullability. Two genuine findings survived verification.
note: mobile-native-kmp (Kotlin/KMP). Top finding: the entire realtor Create-Listing feature is dead in production — the fully-built CreateListingScreen (validation, currency, transaction-type, submitting states) is wired in Navigation.kt to an onSubmit that always returns Result.failure(NotImplementedError("Wire to listing API")), so every publish attempt silently shows publishFailedMsg and no listing is ever created. Not a crash (the Result.failure is folded) but a shipped-yet-nonfunctional user-facing feature. Second finding (test gap): ListingRepository's primary search surface (searchListings, getFeaturedListings, getRecentListings, getSearchSuggestions, getListingsNearby) has no repository-level test — only getListingDetail is covered by ListingDetailRepositoryTest. Both are landable as pure-Kotlin changes, though mobile-native PRs are AGP/ADB-gated in the cloud runner.

evidence: mobile-native/androidApp/src/main/java/three/two/bit/ppt/reality/navigation/Navigation.kt:493 — the Screen.CreateListing composable wires `onSubmit = { _ -> Result.failure(NotImplementedError("Wire to listing API")) }`, a hardcoded always-failing stub. This is the ONLY producer of the CreateListingScreen submit result on a production navigation path (not in a test module).

mobile-native/androidApp/src/main/java/three/two/bit/ppt/reality/ui/realtor/CreateListingScreen.kt:107-129 — the screen is fully implemented (title/city/price validation, currency, transactionType, isSubmitting state) and calls `onSubmit(CreateListingInput(...))`, then `result.fold(onSuccess = { onCreated() }, onFailure = { generalError = if (it.isNetworkError()) networkErrorMsg else publishFailedMsg })`. Because onSubmit always returns Result.failure(NotImplementedError), every realtor publish attempt falls into the onFailure branch and shows publishFailedMsg; no listing is ever created. The feature is shipped but non-functional.

Contrast: PortalListingsRepository already exists and is used elsewhere in Navigation.kt (MyListings calls portalListingsRepository.listMyListings at Navigation.kt:471-476), so the API-backed path exists to wire this to. Fix: replace the stub with a real portalListingsRepository create call returning its Result, and add a repository/ViewModel test asserting a successful create maps to onCreated() and a failure maps to publishFailedMsg. Confidence high: full path traced from screen submit → Navigation stub; no runtime ambiguity.

signals.source: rotating-expert-review (dispatcher Tier-1d 2026-08-30 mobile-native-kmp listing-repo test gap)
evidence: mobile-native/shared/src/commonMain/kotlin/three/two/bit/ppt/reality/listing/ListingRepository.kt:26-118 — six public suspend functions: searchListings (the app's primary search entry point), getListingDetail, getFeaturedListings, getRecentListings, getSearchSuggestions, getListingsNearby.

mobile-native/shared/src/commonTest/kotlin/three/two/bit/ppt/reality/listing/ListingDetailRepositoryTest.kt — the only repository-level test that constructs ListingRepository, and it exercises ONLY getListingDetail (path decode, 404→listing-not-found, 500→failure, listing-id URL-encoding). searchListings/getFeaturedListings/getRecentListings/getSearchSuggestions/getListingsNearby have no repository-level coverage (path/query encoding, decode of the response envelope, error mapping).

Fix: add commonTest cases (mirroring ListingDetailRepositoryTest's MockEngine capturing pattern) for searchListings — query-param encoding of ListingSearchRequest, response decode, error mapping — and smoke coverage for the featured/recent/suggestions/nearby endpoints. Low severity (test gap, not a live bug); confidence medium (coverage absence confirmed by static read, no behavioral bug proven).
